{'translation': 'Autumn is a major season for sports fans, and ESPN has recently rolled out a significant upgrade for users of its tvOS and iOS apps: 4K HDR streaming.', 'type': 'translation'}

{'translation': "ESPN's streaming service now supports 4K HDR, with the tvOS and iOS apps being the first to offer the new capability", 'type': 'translation'}

{'translation': 'Over the past few weeks, ESPN has begun rolling out a major upgrade to its tvOS and iOS apps.', 'type': 'translation'}

{'translation': 'The streaming service now offers 4K HDR picture quality for top-tier programming, including live coverage of the NFL, NBA, NHL, and more.', 'type': 'translation'}

{'translation': "This week, ESPN and ESPN2 will begin broadcasting in 4K HDR in the United States, delivering upgraded visuals during one of the most important live sports windows of the year. This includes all of ESPN's Monday Night Football, NBA and NHL productions, as well as select live coverage of college football and the US Open tennis, along with marquee events such as Super Bowl LXI. The update will bring sharper detail, more vivid colors, and smoother motion — features that are essential to providing sports fans with a richer, more immersive viewing experience. ESPN's iOS and tvOS apps will be the first to support the new experience, with other connected TV platforms following later, and Disney+ in the United States will also make it available to ESPN Unlimited subscribers.", 'type': 'translation'}

{'translation': "When you browse the ESPN app, you'll see a new '4K HDR' badge that flags content supporting higher-quality video streaming.", 'type': 'translation'}

{'translation': 'If you have a stable internet connection at home or on the go, 4K HDR will deliver more vivid, sharper, and higher-quality visuals for your favorite sports content.', 'type': 'translation'}

{'translation': "If any sports fans out there are tempted to splurge on an Apple TV 4K for the first time, we'd suggest holding off — a new Apple TV model is reportedly on the way soon.", 'type': 'translation'}

{'translation': 'Since ESPN rolled out 4K HDR content, have you checked it out? How does it look? Drop us a line in the comments.', 'type': 'translation'}
